text:
maya: Heads up — PR #4123 is green on linux but mac-smoke is failing 1/10 on shard 7. Blocking the merge window for the afternoon. cc @jon @tess

jon: Looking now. Quick glance at the logs shows a snapshot mismatch in the render test — `NSLocalizedString` glyph/layout differences. Could be font fallback or tiny antialiasing shift.

build-bot: mac-smoke shard-7 failed: AssertionError: Image diff 1.8% (threshold 1.0%)

sam: Can we do a targeted rerun for just mac-smoke shard-7 instead of rerunning the whole matrix? /rerun target=mac-smoke shard=7

tess: I can take the diff if rerun fails again. If it's just a sub-pixel shift we might accept and update snapshot, but want to see reproducibility first.

maya: Agreed — rerun first, snapshot update only if failure reproduces. If rerun flakes, we'll hold the merge. Merge slot closes in ~30m.

ci-oncall: Scheduled targeted rerun for job mac-smoke shard-7 (run id: 987654) — ETA ~2m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jon: Thanks. Also note this PR touched the renderer crate and updated a direct-dep (font-utils). Could be related.

build-bot: Rerun started...
```
RUN: pytest tests/smoke_mac.py::test_render --shard=7 --maxfail=1
Collecting tests...
Executing render comparison...
Comparing images (baseline vs current)...
```

sam: Ping @tess once rerun finishes so you can fetch the diffs quickly.

tess: On it. If it's a consistent 1.8% we'll need to decide: increase threshold, accept new snapshot, or revert font change. Prefer snapshot update only if design signs off.

build-bot: Rerun complete: FAIL — Image diff 1.7% (still above threshold). Full diff artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/987654/artifacts/diff.png

jon: It's consistent at ~1.7%. I can try a single-run with a pinned font cache (`FONT_CACHE=clean`) to rule out cache variance.

sam: If you need me to open a tiny follow-up to update snapshots I can do that and mark as "visual-only". Would prefer not to revert code unless necessary.

tess: Please attach the diff and a zoomed-in screenshot of the critical area. Design will weigh in quickly. If it's a resolvable aliasing change, snapshots OK.

maya: OK plan: Jon tries the isolated run with clean font cache (5m). If still reproducible, Sam opens a snapshot-update PR referencing this thread and adds `design-eyes` label. I'll hold merge until we have either updated snapshot PR merged or a revert.

jon: Kicking off:`FONT_CACHE=clean pytest tests/smoke_mac.py::test_render --shard=7 -k render -q`

build-bot: Isolated run complete: FAIL at 1.7% (reproducible). Artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/987660/artifacts/diff.png

sam: I'll open the visual-update PR now: PR #4124 — title "visual: accept updated mac render snapshots for PR #4123". Pushed branch `pr-4123-snap-update`. Link: https://git.internal/pr/4124

tess: I'll review diffs in a minute. If design ok, we merge snapshot PR, then unhold main PR.

maya: Thanks. @jon @tess please add a short rationale in PR description (what changed and why it's safe). I will queue the merge once snapshot PR lands.

jon: Note for record: renderer tweak changed antialias weights by a tiny amount; not functional.

maya: Sounds good — moving to hold state. Thanks all :thumbsup:
